name: Ne~pon? x Raipon!
source:
"Where am I?" 

When the main character wakes up, he finds himself being in a strange world. He doesn't remember anything except for his name.

When he is at a loss what to do, a girl suddenly appears in front of him. According to her, this world's been created to celebrate the Navel's four year anniversary and the Lime's one year anniversary, and he's been invited to the world as a guest. Though he doesn't know what's going on, he gradually gets involved in the festival.

Ten days in a mysterious world. What will happen to him in the end...? 

[From Himeya Shop]

Mahjong-like game with tiles marked with characters of Navel & Lime games instead of standard mahjong tiles.
translation:
‘这里是哪里？’

主人公醒来后，发现自己身处一个陌生世界。除了自己的名字，他什么也不记得。

正当他茫然无措时，一名少女突然出现在面前。据她所说，这个世界是为了庆祝Navel成立四周年与Lime成立一周年而创造的，主人公则受邀以宾客身份来到这里。尽管完全搞不清状况，他还是逐渐被卷入庆典之中。

神秘世界里的十天。他最终会遇到什么……？

[摘自Himeya Shop]

这是一款类似麻将的游戏，牌面并非传统麻将图案，而是Navel与Lime旗下游戏的角色。
